subject: Re: Encord/Tau Robotics - Services for G1_Mobile Project
text:
Hi Richa,

Here is my feedback:
1. I have found the episode but I don't see the issues I have added
anymore. Do you know why they are not visible anymore? Given the video I
can see, I think the scores are good already. Maybe I noted that the second
instruction"place the green book on the white table" could be a 3 as well.
There can be errors in the task instruction transcription, and in this case
I think most people would understand that the user wants something placed
on the table which the robot did.  So you could label it as a 3.

2. If the instruction is in a different language, please use the "can't
judge" option

3. If the robot does not execute the given instruction, it should be given
a low score.

Best,
Alex

subject: Re: Encord/Tau Robotics - Services for G1_Mobile Project

subject: Re: Reminder: your meeting Encord (Kat) <> Riverain (Dennis) [Booth #4711 @RSNA] is about to start
text:
Dear Kat and Winnie,

Just wanted to send a note to thank Kat for meeting with me yesterday! (Sorry I missed you today, Kat!) We discussed some of our needs and what Encord could offer. I do have some more detailed questions on features that I will detail here:

  1.
Annotation platform: I understand from Kat that you already have integrated models like SAM and updates in the tool and have the capability for us to use our own models to do auto/semi auto annotation-great! Im curious about some of the more traditional image processing tools that allow you to modify the annotations esp in the 3d viewer, do you guys now have that capability to: for example lasso cut in the 3d viewer (not just the 2d annotation tool propagating to 3d, but rather annotate directly in the 3d viewer)
  2.
We are interested in a combined framework connecting data annotation tools with ML-ops framework to auto iterate on training/evaluating models while refining annotations. You guys have a robust annotation framework, but do you happen to also offer any ML-ops tools as well? It would be nice to have everything under one framework for us since we currently are stitching together multiple solutions.

Thank you!
Dennis

subject: Re: Encord <> TRI | Data & Projects Best Practices
text:
Hi Shivant,

Thanks for the call. Here's a sample.json file. I'll paste it here too and
walk through our workflow:

{
  "annotation_uuid": "be1c6f6a-ec0c-428e-b2ab-9e5bed557be8",  // annotation
UUID, should be preserved when exporting from Encord
  "encord_file_name":
"fa2c906303cc2214124cf63fe6d7e379ef0add737c6fcd136048b96c9751129f_head_left.mp4",
// This points to the file inside the Encord project
  "encord_project_name" : "Test SDK initialization",
  "encord_project_id" : "5c5ce304-6c95-404d-a59f-a518ade9c307",
  "event_channels": [
    {
      "channel_uuid": "cfc716a5-5648-596e-84ee-359e5dfe33e8", // This is a
mapping from Channel_name to a UUID, and it's the same across all
annotations for all files that have labels in this channel
      "channel_name": "Interaction", // Maps to Encord labeling ontology
      "annotation_type": "LANGUAGE",
      "events": [
        {
          "event_uuid": "973fcc09-fbe5-4d3c-9f10-cf3819eb417a",  // label
UUID, it should be preserved when exporting from Encord
          "description": "Task description 1",  // Text description
          "start_frame": 50,    // Start and end frames in the video
          "end_frame": 1500
        },
        {
          "event_uuid": "f0b161ab-7c0f-467b-ba81-4e2dfbe1d902",
          "description": "Task description 2",
          "start_frame": 2500,
          "end_frame": 5000
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

What we're looking for via the SDK is (in order of importance):

   1. We want to use the data inside the events list to initialize labels
   between the indicated start and end frames and with values set as indicated
   in the description field. The labels should be added within the Encord
   Ontology indicated by the channel_name field; the type of label we've been
   using is of Classification type.
   2. Each event has an event_uuid. When initializing the labels, it would
   be great if this uuid could be maintained inside Encord and preserved when
   exporting the labels.
   3. The en
